name: How do I choose a contractor for my garage-to-bedroom conversion?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for my garage-to-bedroom conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for experience with similar conversion projects and ensure they are properly licensed and insured in Nevada. Check their references and review their portfolio of past work. A reputable contractor will provide a detailed proposal, clear communication, and assist with all necessary permits. Prioritize those who demonstrate a strong understanding of local building codes and design aesthetic to match your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed and insured contractor with experience in conversions. Check references, review portfolios, and ensure they understand local codes and permitting.
